_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); net revenue, credit cost, expense, nonperforming-asset and pre-tax margin signals with JPMorgan Chase's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'JPMorgan Chase & Co. ... is a leading financial services firm based in the United States' 'Unfavorable market and economic conditions can have an adverse effect on JPMorganChase’s wholesale businesses.' 'JPMorganChase operates in a highly competitive environment in which it must evolve and adapt to changes in financial regulation, technological advances, increased public scrutiny and changes in economic conditions.' (FY2024 10-K); DURABLE, risk 2: the 10-K ties results to markets and the economy, a cycle and a competitive field, and does not call its own business cyclical (the word appears only in 'countercyclical capital buffer', a regulatory term: the LOW and SHW reading); among its competitors it lists 'e-commerce and other internet-based companies, financial technology companies'; it says 'both financial institutions and their non-banking competitors face the risk that payments processing and other products and services, including deposits and other traditional banking products, could be significantly disrupted by the use of new technologies, such as cryptocurrencies and other applications using secure distributed ledgers, that may not require intermediation'; CRYPTO is live (from 2020-10-21) and scoped to banks and payments: these words put it on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for JPMorgan Chase

theme_watch.reason: Live: JPMorgan Chase's own FY2024 10-K says 'both financial institutions and their non-banking competitors face the risk that payments processing and other products and services, including deposits and other traditional banking products, could be significantly disrupted by the use of new technologies, such as cryptocurrencies and other applications using secure distributed ledgers, that may not require intermediation'. The stock trades at 17.0x FY25E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CRYPTO) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing crypto disintermediation of JPMorgan Chase's payments and banking specifically.

'JPMorganChase operates in a highly competitive environment in which it must evolve and adapt to changes in financial regulation, technological advances, increased public scrutiny and changes in economic conditions.' (FY2024 10-K); DURABLE, risk 2: the 10-K ties results to markets and the economy, a cycle and a competitive field, and does not call its own business cyclical (the word appears only in 'countercyclical capital buffer', a regulatory term: the LOW and SHW reading); among its competitors it lists 'e-commerce and other internet-based companies, financial technology companies'; it says 'both financial institutions and their non-banking competitors face the risk that payments processing and other products and services, including deposits and other traditional banking products, could be significantly disrupted by the use of new technologies, such as cryptocurrencies and other applications using secure distributed ledgers, that may not require intermediation'; CRYPTO is live (from 2020-10-21) and scoped to banks and payments: these words put it on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for JPMorgan Chase. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +89% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.97; conservative 2yr -38%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -21.3%/yr (worst year FY15-FY24, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -7.4%/yr (Q2 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +13.1%/yr (FY15-FY24 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +24.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY15-FY24, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: JPM (retrospective, 2025-10-03) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (66.5% downside to Bear $103.87 / -4.5% upside to Bull $296.16) | Adj composite 1.80 vs market 3.77: gap -1.97 [OVERVALUED] | +89% above the EPP floor $163.98 (9x FY25E $18.22) | Conservative 2-yr case: -37.5% total (-18.8%/yr) | At 17.0x FY25E the 15% hurdle price $410.01 sits above the BULL case; revenue -10.5% YoY in Q2 2025, forward revenues -10.5% (Q2 2025 revenue growth (no Q3 2025 guide)); crypto is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
